display.tagline: Turn a finished blog post into a published Quintel article with a generated hero image.
display.description: Takes a written markdown blog post, derives a wordless hero-image concept via the concept-llm connection (MiniMax-M3), generates a 16:9 hero image via the image-gen connection (MiniMax image-01), uploads it as a public CDN asset, and publishes the post through the repository's guarded publisher (bun run blog:publish / blog:validate) into the Quintel blog table — idempotent by slug, drafts-first, with the SEO/GEO editorial fields (answer_summary, primary_query, content_cluster, related_slugs) required before publish.
capabilities: Derive a staged, wordless hero-image concept and style from post content via the concept-llm connection
Generate a 16:9 hero image via the image-gen connection (URL response, fetched immediately)
Upload the hero as a public CDN asset with reproducibility metadata (style, seed, concept, full prompt)
Collect and validate the SEO/GEO editorial contract (answer_summary, primary_query, content_cluster, related_slugs) with the operator before any write
Run a clean-context editorial QC pass on the derived metadata fields before the CMS write
Publish via the repository's guarded publisher (bun run blog:publish + blog:validate), never a raw table write
Harden unpublish/delete against dangling related_slugs references in the published corpus

connectionBindings.name: concept-llm
connectionBindings.purpose: Anthropic-compatible LLM endpoint (MiniMax-M3) used to pick a style key and author the staged, wordless concept sentence for the hero image

connectionBindings.name: image-gen
connectionBindings.purpose: MiniMax image API (image-01) used to generate the 16:9 hero image; returns a URL so the response stays under the 5MB proxy cap
